FN-FKEVVD5-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 372
Committee: Insurance Sponsor: Representative Phillip Rigsby
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 02/09/2026
House Bill 372 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Department of Insurance by
an undetermined amount dependent on the cost of compensation and benefit of the staff that
may be hired within the Pharmacy Benefit Manager (PBM) Division, including up to two
employees exempt from the merit system. These obligations would be offset by PBM license
fees collected by the department, as provided by current law.
